purpose: Feasible-region definition for India recurring-payment recovery. Constraints are hard, sourced, and non-overridable. They define what the agent is FORBIDDEN or REQUIRED to do. Policy (policy.decline-actions.json) only picks among actions this catalog leaves ALLOWED.

verdicts.block: Action is forbidden. Remove from feasible set.
verdicts.require_action: No auto-recovery is possible. Event collapses to a customer-action path (re-register / AFA). Blocks all money-moving actions.
verdicts.defer: Do not act yet. A timing window is unelapsed or another owner (gateway) will act. Re-evaluate later.

evaluation.order: Evaluate constraints top-to-bottom by group: domain_scope -> consent_fraud -> mandate_lifecycle -> rbi_emandate -> scheme_rail -> comms_trai -> idempotency_stopping. Deny always wins. A single require_action collapses the event to customer-action. mandate_* groups only apply to domain=recurring (checkout/receivables carry mandate_status=n/a).
evaluation.feasible_set_algorithm: Start with all actions allowed. Apply each constraint whose `when` matches. Remove every action in `blocks_actions`. Record each firing in feasible.json with its id + source. Output: feasible actions + vetoes.
evaluation.timezone: All time conditions evaluated in IST (UTC+05:30) against the intended action time, not occurred_at.

unknown_handling.principle: Fail closed. Missing data never unlocks a money-moving or promotional action.
rules: mandate_status unknown -> treat as require_action (cannot prove debit authority). CLASSIFY must first infer it from subscription/event status (pending->active, halted->halted, cancelled->cancelled) so this only fires when truly unknown (F2).
pre_debit_notice_sent unknown -> block schedule_retry only (cannot prove 24h notice for a merchant-initiated debit). defer_to_gateway exempt (F1).
customer_dnd unknown -> block promotional whatsapp (dunning_whatsapp); allow email + transactional whatsapp (mandate_reregister).
fraud_flag unknown -> allow (absence is not a positive flag), but log.
amount_paise unknown -> block money_moving above-threshold checks cannot be cleared.

constraints.source: Detector-originated recurring case: nothing has failed yet, the scheduled charge will run on its own. Any extra debit would be an unauthorised duplicate under the RBI e-mandate (one debit per billing cycle per mandate).
constraints.note: Pre-failure cases are contact-only: warn the customer / fix the mandate before the scheduled debit.

constraints.source: No mandate exists for an abandoned checkout or an invoice; the merchant has no authority to pull funds. Recovery is a customer-initiated payment via link only.
constraints.note: Checkout and receivables domains are contact-only by construction.

constraints.source: Merchant risk policy / platform fraud control. Razorpay Agent Studio: fraud-flagged customers receive no automated contact.
constraints.note: A suspected-fraud event is never auto-recovered or contacted. Human-only.

constraints.source: DPDPA 2023 consent; TRAI TCCCPR. A recorded opt-out is permanent suppression.
constraints.note: Opt-out blocks all outreach. Money-moving may still be gateway-owned but customer-action paths are dead.

constraints.source: RBI Digital Payments E-mandate Framework 2026 - a revoked/cancelled mandate confers no debit authority. Withdrawal requires AFA.
constraints.note: Never retry a cancelled mandate. Only path is fresh AFA registration by the customer.

constraints.source: Razorpay Subscriptions states - in `halted`, invoices generate but no auto-charge is attempted; prior invoices are not re-charged on reactivation.
constraints.note: Halted = retries already exhausted. No auto-charge. Customer must update card / re-authenticate.

constraints.source: Razorpay Subscriptions states.
constraints.note: Same as mandate_halted but keyed on the event type when mandate_status is not populated.

constraints.source: RBI E-mandate Framework 2026 - customer may pause/modify a mandate; no debit while paused.
constraints.note: Do not retry while paused. Re-evaluate if/when resumed.

constraints.source: RBI E-mandate Framework 2026 - first transaction / registration requires AFA validation.
constraints.note: No mandate on file = no off-session debit authority.

constraints.source: RBI E-mandate Framework 2026 - recurring debits above Rs 15,000 require AFA on each transaction (general category).
constraints.note: Above Rs 15,000 there is no silent auto-debit; each charge needs per-transaction AFA.

constraints.source: RBI E-mandate Framework 2026 - Rs 1,00,000 AFA-free ceiling for insurance premiums, mutual fund subscriptions, credit-card bill payments.
constraints.note: Exempt categories get the higher Rs 1,00,000 threshold before per-transaction AFA is required.

constraints.source: RBI E-mandate Framework 2026 - issuer must send pre-debit notification at least 24h before any recurring debit. A debit without prior notice is rejected outright, not soft-declined.
constraints.note: No notice -> no MERCHANT-initiated debit. defer_to_gateway is exempt: the gateway owns its own pre-debit compliance (F1).

constraints.source: RBI E-mandate Framework 2026 - minimum 24h between pre-debit notice and debit.
constraints.note: Notice sent but 24h not elapsed. Defer the debit until the window closes.

constraints.source: RBI E-mandate Framework 2026 / NPCI - minimum 24h before re-presenting a failed mandate execution, and each retry needs a fresh 24h pre-debit notice.
constraints.note: No same-day re-presentation. Each retry restarts the 24h notice clock.

constraints.source: Card scheme rules - hard declines (expired card, invalid account, 'do not retry' response codes) will not succeed on re-presentment; Visa/Mastercard levy excessive-reattempt fees. Gateways do not auto-retry hard declines.
constraints.note: Never retry a hard decline. Only customer action (update card / re-register) can recover it (F4 - found by batch simulation).

constraints.source: Razorpay Subscriptions - gateway auto-retries soft declines (T+1/2/3). Duplicating merchant retries wastes attempts and scheme goodwill.
constraints.note: Let the gateway own the soft-decline retry. Only build custom retry if gateway timing provably misses payday (a policy/heuristic decision, not a constraint).

constraints.source: Card scheme re-presentment caps - Visa 15 per 30 days, Mastercard 10 per 35 days (defaults; exact cap resolved from card_network).
constraints.note: Beyond the scheme cap, further retries risk penalties/fines. Route to customer action.

constraints.source: NPCI UPI AutoPay - general recurring cap Rs 15,000 per transaction without per-debit UPI PIN. Above this UPI cannot silently auto-debit.
constraints.note: UPI AutoPay above Rs 15,000 needs per-debit UPI PIN. Consider offering an alternate rail on re-registration.

constraints.source: TRAI TCCCPR 2018 - promotional voice/SMS restricted to 09:00-21:00. Applied to promotional WhatsApp/SMS/voice; transactional email exempt.
constraints.note: In quiet hours, defer promotional outreach to 09:00 IST; email still allowed.

constraints.source: TRAI DND registry - blocks promotional SMS/voice. Transactional email and consented transactional messages survive.
constraints.note: DND suppresses promotional SMS/voice/WhatsApp. Use email for these customers.

constraints.source: Comms policy (TRAI-aligned anti-harassment) - max 3 contacts per customer per rolling 7 days.
constraints.note: Hard cap on outreach frequency. Prevents customer harassment.

constraints.source: Comms policy (TRAI-aligned) - minimum 12h gap between outreach touches.
constraints.note: Space out contact. Defer until 12h since last touch.

constraints.source: Idempotency (internal) - webhooks are at-least-once. A payment_id already processed must not trigger a second action.
constraints.note: Duplicate delivery -> noop. Mirrors gate G3_IDEMPOTENT.

constraints.source: Policy + scheme caps - once per-class retry budget is spent, further silent retries are wasteful. Route to customer action or dunning.
constraints.note: Retry budget exhausted: no more debits (merchant or gateway). NOT a require_action - the mandate may still be live, so the planner picks the cheapest contact (email before re-register) (F3).
